cues.zh: 自工业革命以来，人类已经释放了
cues.en: Since the Industrial Revolution, humans have released

cues.zh: 超过1.5万亿吨的二氧化碳或CO₂进入地球大气层。
cues.en: over 1.5 trillion tons of carbon dioxide or CO₂, into the Earth's atmosphere.

cues.zh: 2019年，我们仍然排放了约370亿吨。
cues.en: In the year 2019, we were still pumping out around 37 billion more.

cues.zh: 这比2000年增加了50%，几乎是50年前的三倍。
cues.en: That's 50 percent more than the year 2000 and almost three times as much as 50 years ago.

cues.zh: 而且不仅仅是CO₂，
cues.en: And it's not just CO₂,

cues.zh: 我们还在排放越来越多的其他温室气体，比如甲烷和一氧化二氮。
cues.en: we're also pumping out growing volumes of other greenhouse gases such as methane and nitrous oxide.

cues.zh: 把所有温室气体加在一起，我们每年排放510亿吨二氧化碳当量。
cues.en: Combining all of our greenhouse gases, we're emitting 51 billion tons of carbon dioxide equivalents each year.

cues.zh: 而且排放量还在上升。
cues.en: And emissions keep rising.

cues.zh: 但它们需要降到零。
cues.en: But they need to get down to zero.

cues.zh: 近年来，后果变得更加严重和明显。
cues.en: In recent years, the consequences have become more serious and visible.

cues.zh: 几乎每年都在打破一些可怕的记录：
cues.en: Almost every year breaks some horrible record:

cues.zh: 我们有更多的热浪，最多的冰川融化，以及北极有记录以来最低的冰量。
cues.en: We've had more heat waves, the most glaciers melting, and the lowest amount of ice ever recorded at the North Pole.

cues.zh: 过去22年中有20年是有记录以来最热的年份。
cues.en: Of the last 22 years, 20 have been the hottest on record.

cues.zh: 要遏制这种快速的气候变化，唯一的办法就是迅速减少我们的集体排放。
cues.en: The only way to limit this rapid climate change is to decrease our collective emissions quickly.

cues.zh: 但尽管所有国家原则上都认同这一目标，
cues.en: But although all countries agree on this goal in principle,

cues.zh: 他们在谁该负责、谁该承担最重负担的问题上却意见不一。
cues.en: they do not agree who is responsible or who should bear the heaviest load.

cues.zh: 发达国家指出自身在减排方面的努力，
cues.en: The developed countries point at their own efforts to reduce emissions

cues.zh: 以及正在崛起的大型发展中国家、尤其是中国，
cues.en: and the fact that the large developing countries on the rise, especially China,

cues.zh: 目前排放的二氧化碳要多得多。
cues.en: are currently releasing much more CO₂.

cues.zh: 另一方面，发展中国家认为西方的排放是生活方式型排放，
cues.en: On the other hand, developing countries argue that emissions by the West are lifestyle emissions,

cues.zh: 而对发展中国家来说，这些是生存型排放。
cues.en: while for developing countries, they are survival emissions.

cues.zh: 还有人称富国是伪君子——靠无节制污染致富，
cues.en: Others call rich countries hypocrites that got rich by polluting without restraint

cues.zh: 如今却指望别人不要工业化、继续贫穷。
cues.en: and now expect others not to industrialize and stay poor.

cues.zh: 那么，谁应该为气候变化和二氧化碳排放负责？
cues.en: So who is responsible for climate change and CO₂ emissions?

cues.zh: 而且不管过去如何，今天谁最需要采取行动？
cues.en: And regardless of the past, who needs to do the most today?

cues.zh: 在本视频中，我们只讨论民族国家。
cues.en: In this video, we'll talk exclusively about nation-states.

cues.zh: 我们将在另一个视频中探讨化石燃料行业。
cues.en: We'll look at the fossil fuel industry in another video.

cues.zh: 三个问题中的第一个：今天哪些国家排放的二氧化碳最多？
cues.en: Question 1 of 3: Which countries emit the most carbon dioxide today?

cues.zh: 2017年，人类排放了约360亿吨二氧化碳。
cues.en: In 2017, humans emitted about 36 billion tons of CO₂.

cues.zh: 超过50%来自亚洲。北美和欧洲紧随其后，分别占18%和17%。
cues.en: More than 50% came from Asia. North America and Europe followed with 18% and 17%.

cues.zh: 而非洲、南美洲和大洋洲加起来只贡献了8%。
cues.en: While Africa, South America, and Oceania together only contributed eight percent.

cues.zh: 中国是迄今为止世界上最大的排放国，每年排放100亿吨二氧化碳，
cues.en: China is by far the world's largest emitter with 10 billion tons of CO₂ every year,

cues.zh: 占全球排放量的27%。
cues.en: or 27% of global emissions.

cues.zh: 其次是美国，占15%，欧盟约占10%。
cues.en: It's followed by the USA with 15% and the European Union with around 10%.

cues.zh: 加起来，这超过了全球二氧化碳排放量的一半。
cues.en: Together, this is more than half of the world's CO₂ emissions.

cues.zh: 显然，如果没有这三大工业集团的意愿和行动，
cues.en: So it's clear that without the willingness and action of these three industrial blocs,

cues.zh: 人类就无法实现碳中和，也无法防止严重的气候变化。
cues.en: humanity will not be able to become carbon neutral and prevent severe climate change.

cues.zh: 接下来是印度7%、俄罗斯5%、日本3%，
cues.en: Next on our list is India at seven percent, Russia at five percent, Japan at three percent,

cues.zh: 以及伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、韩国和加拿大，都略低于2%。
cues.en: and Iran, Saudi Arabia, South Korea, and Canada all just short of two percent.

cues.zh: 加上前三名，前十名国家贡献了全球75%的排放量。
cues.en: Together with the first three, the top 10 are responsible for 75% of global emissions.

cues.zh: 但只看当前情况，我们看到的并不全面。
cues.en: But if we only look at the current situation, we're not getting the full picture.

cues.zh: 第2题，共3题：哪些国家历史累计排放最多？
cues.en: Question 2 of 3: Which countries have emitted the most in total?

cues.zh: 纵观有史以来的排放总量，情况就大不相同了。
cues.en: If we look at emissions throughout history until today, the outlook changes drastically.

cues.zh: 美国和欧盟都把中国挤下了榜首。
cues.en: The US and the EU both knock China off the top spot.

cues.zh: 美国对全球历史排放量的25%负有责任，排放了4000亿吨，
cues.en: The US is responsible for 25% of the world's historical emissions emitting 400 billion tons,

cues.zh: 主要是在20世纪。
cues.en: mostly in the 20ᵗʰ century.

cues.zh: 排在第二位的是欧盟，占22%。
cues.en: In second place is the EU at 22%.

cues.zh: 中国以略低于13%排在第三，约为美国贡献的一半。
cues.en: China comes in third at just under 13 percent, around half of the USA's contribution.

cues.zh: 印度的贡献缩减到3%，整个非洲和南美洲也是如此。
cues.en: India's contribution shrinks to 3 percent along with the whole of Africa and South America.

cues.zh: 英国占全球年排放量的1%，
cues.en: The UK is responsible for one percent of annual global emissions

cues.zh: 却承担了5%的历史责任。
cues.en: but takes five percent of the historical responsibility.

cues.zh: 德国如今每年产生2%的排放，却贡献了近6%，
cues.en: Germany, producing two percent of emissions per year today, has contributed almost six percent,

cues.zh: 相当于整个非洲和南美洲的总和。
cues.en: as much as the whole of Africa and South America combined.

cues.zh: 所以，快速气候变化真的是发展中国家的责任这一说法
cues.en: So the narrative that rapid climate change is really the responsibility of the developing world

cues.zh: 如果你在乎事实，就很难站得住脚。
cues.en: is hard to defend if facts matter to you.

cues.zh: 但这还不是全部，因为只关注国家会把两件事混在一起：
cues.en: But this is still not the whole story, because focusing on countries mixes two things:

cues.zh: 人口数量和总排放量。
cues.en: population numbers and total emissions.

cues.zh: 如果一个国家总体上人口更多，它的排放量自然更高。
cues.en: If a country has more people in general, its emissions are of course higher.

cues.zh: 但如果我们看的是像你这样的个体，亲爱的观众，情况就大不相同了。
cues.en: Things look very different if we look at individuals like you, dear viewer.

cues.zh: 第3个问题，共3个：哪些国家的人均二氧化碳排放量最高？
cues.en: Question 3 of 3: Which countries emit the most carbon dioxide per person?

cues.zh: 普通人每年大约排放五吨二氧化碳，但平均值可能会误导人。
cues.en: The average human is responsible for around five tons of CO₂ each year, but averages can be misleading.

cues.zh: 人均二氧化碳排放量最高的国家，是一些世界主要的石油和天然气生产国。
cues.en: The countries with the largest CO₂ emissions per person are some of the world's major oil and gas producers.

cues.zh: 2017年，卡塔尔的人均排放量最高，高达每人49吨，
cues.en: In 2017, Qatar had the highest emissions at a hefty 49 tons per person,

cues.zh: 其次是特立尼达和多巴哥、科威特、阿拉伯联合酋长国、文莱、巴林和沙特阿拉伯。
cues.en: followed by Trinidad and Tobago, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Brunei, Bahrain, and Saudi Arabia.

cues.zh: 但那些只是离群值。
cues.en: But those are outliers.

cues.zh: 澳大利亚的人均碳足迹是最高的之一：每年 17 吨。
cues.en: Australians have one of the highest carbon footprints per person: 17 tons a year.

cues.zh: 是全球平均水平的三倍多，
cues.en: That's more than triple the global average

cues.zh: 也略高于美国人和加拿大人均的 16 吨。
cues.en: and slightly more than the average US American and Canadian at 16 tons.

cues.zh: 德国人稍好一些，接近 10 吨，但仍是全球平均水平的两倍。
cues.en: The Germans do a little better at close to 10 tons, but this is still twice the global average.

cues.zh: 中国可能是世界上排放量最大的国家，
cues.en: China may be the world's largest emitter,

cues.zh: 但它也是世界上人口最多的国家，有超过 14 亿人，
cues.en: but it's also the world's most populous country with over 1.4 billion people,

cues.zh: 占世界人口的 18.5%。
cues.en: 18.5% of the world population.

cues.zh: 人均排放量为 7 吨，高于平均水平。
cues.en: Per person, it's above average at seven tons.

cues.zh: 从历史上看，二氧化碳排放一直与高生活水平密切相关。
cues.en: Historically, CO₂ emissions have been closely tied to a high standard of living.

cues.zh: 财富是我们碳足迹最强的指标之一，因为当我们从贫穷走向富裕时，
cues.en: Wealth is one of the strongest indicators of our carbon footprint, because as we move from poor to rich,

cues.zh: 我们获得了电力、供暖、空调、照明、现代烹饪、
cues.en: we gain access to electricity, heating, air conditioning, lighting, modern cooking,

cues.zh: 汽车或飞机、智能手机、电脑，并在网上与世界各地的人互动。
cues.en: cars or planes, smartphones, computers, and interact with people across the world online.

cues.zh: 中国二氧化碳排放量的大幅上升，伴随着历史上最大规模的脱贫。
cues.en: The enormous rise of China's CO₂ emissions is coupled with the greatest reduction of poverty in history.

cues.zh: 如果我们按收入对二氧化碳排放量排序，
cues.en: If we order CO₂ emissions by income,

cues.zh: 就会看到，最富裕的一半国家贡献了全球86%的排放，
cues.en: we see that the richest half of countries are responsible for 86% of global emissions

cues.zh: 而较贫穷的一半国家只占14%。
cues.en: and the bottom half for only 14%.

cues.zh: 德国人均排放量是印度人均的五倍多。
cues.en: The average German emits more than five times as much as the average Indian.

cues.zh: 美国人平均只需2.3天，排放量就相当于尼日利亚人一年的排放量。
cues.en: In just 2.3 days, the average American emits as much as the average Nigerian in a year.

cues.zh: 不仅如此，严酷的现实是，
cues.en: And not only that, the harsh reality is that

cues.zh: 对这个问题贡献最小的国家，反而可能在快速气候变化中损失最大。
cues.en: it's the countries that contribute least to the problem that stand to lose the most from rapid climate change.

cues.zh: 发展中国家将受到的冲击最严重。
cues.en: The developing world will be hit the hardest.

cues.zh: 后果可能是粮食不安全、资源冲突，
cues.en: The consequences could be food insecurity, conflicts over resources,

cues.zh: 更严酷、更频繁的自然灾害，以及大规模的气候难民潮。
cues.en: harsher and more frequent natural disasters, and large climate refugee movements.

cues.zh: 问题4……共3题：那么谁该承担责任？
cues.en: Question 4... of 3: So who should take responsibility?

cues.zh: 当今许多最富裕的国家处于一个有利位置。
cues.en: Many of today's richest countries are in a convenient position.

cues.zh: 它们是在数百年的化石燃料燃烧和工业生产中变得富裕的。
cues.en: They have become rich over centuries of fossil fuel burning and industrial production.

cues.zh: 它们有着巨大的历史足迹，而它们的财富意味着它们人均排放量仍然很高。
cues.en: They have a large historical footprint, and their wealth means they still emit a lot per person.

cues.zh: 但它们国家现在的年排放量与其他国家相比已相形见绌，
cues.en: But their country's annual emissions are now dwarfed by other countries,

cues.zh: 因为中国这个巨无霸终于赶上来了，而像印度这样的其他巨头也在路上。
cues.en: because the giant that is China is finally catching up, and other giants like India are on their way.

cues.zh: 例如，许多德国人想知道，如果德国只占年排放量的百分之二，
cues.en: Many Germans, for example, wonder how if Germany only accounts for two percent of yearly emissions,

cues.zh: 它怎么能对减排产生有意义的影响。
cues.en: it can have a meaningful impact on reducing emissions.

cues.zh: 答案很简单。
cues.en: The answer is simple.

cues.zh: 首先，最富裕的国家拥有资源、受过高等教育劳动力和技术
cues.en: For one, the richest countries have the resources, highly educated workforces, and technology

cues.zh: 来开发低成本、低碳的解决方案，并将其传播到世界各地。
cues.en: to develop low-cost, low-carbon solutions and spread them around the world.

cues.zh: 如果我们不想让较贫穷的国家变得像我们一样依赖化石燃料，
cues.en: If we don't want poorer countries to become as fossil fuel-dependent as we are,

cues.zh: 就需要让低碳技术变得廉价且易于获取。
cues.en: we need low-carbon technology to be cheap and available.

cues.zh: 而我们正在朝这个方向前进。
cues.en: And we're getting there.

cues.zh: 可再生能源的成本正在快速下降，许多不同领域也都有多种解决方案即将问世。
cues.en: The cost of renewables is falling quickly and a variety of solutions are on the horizon for many different sectors.

cues.zh: 但这需要发生得快得多。
cues.en: But it needs to happen much faster.

cues.zh: 如果西方富裕国家决定认真应对快速的气候变化，
cues.en: If the rich countries of the West decide to seriously tackle rapid climate change,

cues.zh: 世界其他地区就会跟进，因为他们别无选择。
cues.en: the rest of the world would follow, because it has no choice.

cues.zh: 就像当年欧盟对技术实施能效标准时，
cues.en: Just like when the European Union enforced energy efficiency standards for technology,

cues.zh: 世界其他地区也纷纷采纳，因为他们希望能继续与该联盟进行贸易。
cues.en: the rest of the world adopted them too, because they wanted to be able to continue trading with the block.

cues.zh: 尽管如此，这并不能免除其他国家的责任。
cues.en: Still, this doesn't absolve others of their responsibility.

cues.zh: 中国是当今最大的二氧化碳排放国，中国有责任以一种能够及时
cues.en: China is the largest CO₂ emitter today, and it's China's responsibility to grow in a way

cues.zh: 向零碳世界过渡的方式实现增长。
cues.en: that will make it possible to transition to a zero-carbon world in time.

cues.zh: 别人昨天不负责任的行为，不能成为今天重蹈覆辙的糟糕借口。
cues.en: Others acting irresponsibly yesterday is a horrible excuse for repeating the same mistakes today.

cues.zh: 气候变化是全球性问题，没有哪个国家能独自解决。
cues.en: Climate change is a global problem, and no country alone can fix it.

cues.zh: 厘清谁该负责并不像看起来那么简单，某种程度上，这还是个愚蠢的问题，
cues.en: Working out who's responsible is not as simple as it seems, and in a way, it's a daft question,

cues.zh: 但这个问题已经困扰国际政治几十年了。
cues.en: but one that has plagued international politics for decades.

cues.zh: 说到底，其实很简单。
cues.en: In the end, it's pretty simple.

cues.zh: 每个国家都需要尽力而为，而眼下我们都没有做到。
cues.en: Everybody needs to do the best they can, and right now we are all not doing that.

cues.zh: 但我们可以从今天开始。
cues.en: But we can begin today.

cues.en: This video is part of a series about climate change supported by Breakthrough Energy,

cues.zh: 这是一个由 Bill Gates 创立的联盟，致力于扩大清洁能源投资，
cues.en: a coalition founded by Bill Gates that's working to expand clean energy investment

cues.zh: 并支持那些将引领世界实现净零碳排放的创新。
cues.en: and support the innovations that will lead the world to net zero carbon emissions.

cues.zh: 同时，特别感谢 Our World in Data 团队在数据和研究方面给予我们的帮助。
cues.en: Also, a special thanks to the team at Our World in Data for helping us out with data and research.
